_about: B5 prices (static, sourced). Utilities from EIA public data; steam is a two-factor model (capital + fuel-coupled energy) so it responds to natural-gas price. Chemicals from TEA literature (representative US-GC; exact contract prices need a feed — G3). Live scheduled refresh is the deferred future plan.

sources.title: US EIA energy prices (electricity, natural gas)
sources.reference_citation: U.S. Energy Information Administration: industrial electricity and natural gas prices (2024 averages).
sources.notes: Real public energy prices. Steam derived via two-factor model.

sources.title: TEA-literature chemical reference prices
sources.reference_citation: Representative US-GC commodity prices from published techno-economic analyses; refine with a price feed (G3).
sources.notes: Approximate; chemicals lack free citable spot feeds — gap-logged G3.

utilities.notes: EIA industrial natural gas ~2024 (~$4.2/MMBtu). Fuel for two-factor steam.
Two-factor: price = 1.5 (capital) + 1.25 (1/boiler-eff) * natural_gas. Recomputes on fuel-price change. price field is the nominal fallback.
